pure_adapter_freeze.schema_resolution: NFKC and surrounding trim are applied only to metadata labels. Exactly one frozen label must resolve for issuer code, action type/family, action date and document href; duplicate, missing, ambiguous, fuzzy and unknown labels fail closed.

canonicalization.supported_instruments: SSE main board and SZSE main board/ChiNext only
canonicalization.document_href_policy: resolve only against the frozen official listing page, require HTTPS on the same official host, preserve path/query/case/percent encoding and persist only SHA-256
canonicalization.ignored_free_text_policy: never enter normalized output or factor logic

page_metadata_mapping.reason_unset: The source contract forbids guessing endpoint or pagination parameters. A later metadata-only official static-page inspection must be separately recorded before any list/API row request.

complete_library_semantic_review.independence_decision: Formal enforcement is a realized exchange compliance action rather than an inquiry request. The new definition does not reuse an inquiry row, count, three-calendar-day formula, title, document body or return result. If the enforcement listings do not explicitly carry a supported issuer code, the new source fails rather than mining text or reviving the earlier rejected regulatory-measure burden route.

single_factor_definition.name: official_exchange_enforcement_recovery_session_age_60sessions
single_factor_definition.formula: For signal session s, let each canonical event effective session e be the first accepted local trading session strictly after action_date. Keep events with 0 <= session_index(s) - session_index(e) <= 59, choose the latest e, and return session_index(s) - session_index(e).
single_factor_definition.economic_interpretation: Among issuers with a formal enforcement action in the active 60-session window, a longer clean accepted-session interval since the latest action is ranked as greater recovery. It does not rank unaffected issuers and does not infer action severity.
single_factor_definition.missing_semantics: Missing when no canonical supported event has an effective session within the active 60-session window. Absence is never zero, favorable, imputed or ranked.
single_factor_definition.same_effective_session_multiple_events: The latest effective-session age is unchanged; event family or count is not used as a tie-breaker or weight.
single_factor_definition.availability: Signal first exists at the effective session close; earliest entry is the next accepted session open and exit is the third accepted session close after entry.

next_gate.allowed: Freeze official static metadata endpoint/schema/pagination mapping without inspecting list rows, then freeze an atomic one-shot zero-return source acceptance workflow bound to the adapter, tests, formula and all local fingerprints.
next_gate.not_allowed: Do not request a list/API response, inspect/count/persist a source row, load candidate/comparator values, read prices/returns, open 2024-2025 stress, or change the formula after source evidence.
